summary: Sun 03 Aug 2026. DA3-Streaming PHASE 2 COMPLETE for 0.00 USD - pose converter written and VALIDATED. Created vaultwares_studio/streaming_convert.py converting streaming's flat output (camera_poses.txt C2W + intrinsic.txt + combined_pcd.ply) into transforms.json + sparse_pc.ply so Job B/splatfacto needs zero changes. Validation method: ran streaming on EXACTLY the 80 frames the known-good da3-standard run (local-run-20260713-022745) used, then Umeyama-aligned trajectories. Key insight enabling independent tests: the OpenCV->OpenGL flip negates Y/Z rotation columns but leaves the translation column untouched, so POSITION validates C2W-vs-W2C while ORIENTATION validates the flip. RESULTS: orientation median 9.07deg with flip vs 178.91deg without (near-perfect inversion = decisive); position RMSE 11.9pct of extent correct vs 26.0pct if wrongly inverting. Both conventions confirmed: do NOT invert (streaming already emits C2W), DO apply diag(1,-1,-1,1) on the right. 16 tests pin both failure modes; mutation-tested both (removing flip and adding inversion each break the suite). Residual analysed and is TAIL DRIFT not a converter bug: frames 16-63 agree to 5-7deg median, frames 64-79 degrade to 36deg median - accumulated SIM3 drift with loop_enable:False on frames sampled ~1.6s apart (adversarial for a sequential-video method). This raises phase 5 loop closure from optional to likely-required for long sequences. Explicitly NOT an accuracy claim - reference is another DA3 estimate not ground truth; numbers validate conventions only. 128 tests passing. Pushed 966be28 to main with v1.2.0 bump. Phases 1+2 both done at zero cost; phase 3 (full 500 frames -> processed_min.zip) is next and is the real value decision point.
